description: Defines the implementation of a PDxCH baseband processor class, including its configuration, constructor, and key methods for processing slots, handling requests, and managing modulation completion. It manages modulators, buffers, and frequency control for downlink physical channels in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: pdxch_processor_impl
classes.description: Implements a downlink physical channel baseband processor handling modulation, buffer management, and frequency control.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a notifier to the processor for event notifications.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the processor to stop accepting new transmissions and waits for ongoing tasks to complete.

methods.name: get_request_handler
methods.description: Returns the request handler interface for processing resource requests.

methods.name: get_baseband
methods.description: Returns the baseband interface for processing slots.

methods.name: process_slot
methods.description: Processes a slot based on the provided context, returning the result.

methods.name: handle_request
methods.description: Handles resource grid requests for downlink transmission.

methods.name: set_carrier_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the carrier center frequency in Hz.

methods.name: on_modulation_completion
methods.description: Callback invoked upon modulation completion, handling the result.
